title: Tom has two homes
summary: Rose's lazy gray cat has a busy day, and a secret door.

items.example: There's a small tree in the garden.
Rose only knows about one home.

sections.title: Read and listen
sections.heading: Tom has two homes
paragraphs: Tom is Rose's cat. He's gray, and he's very lazy.
He sleeps on Rose's bed until nine o'clock every morning.
At ten, he eats his breakfast in the kitchen.
At noon, he sits in the window and watches the birds in the garden.
In the afternoon, Tom goes out into the garden. He climbs the small tree, but he never catches a bird.
At seven in the evening, Rose goes to bed with a book.
Then Tom walks quietly to the door of apartment 4B.
Elif opens the door, and Tom sits on her desk next to her drawings.
Tom has two homes, and two friends.
But Rose only knows about one of them!

support.tr: Tekrar oku. Doğru mu, yanlış mı?
support.ar: اقرأ مرة أخرى. صح أم خطأ؟

items.statement: At noon, Tom is in the garden.
Tom catches a lot of birds.
In the evening, Tom visits Elif.
Rose knows about Tom's second home.

sections.title: Tom's day
items: He watches the birds from the window.
He climbs the tree in the garden.
